title: LMDT: Local Manifold Dispersion Test
text: LMDT implements Local Manifold Dispersion Test detecting complex, non-linear, high-dimensional heteroskedasticity linear regression models. Unlike classical tests (Breusch–Pagan, White) rely restrictive linear specifications suffer degrees--freedom explosion p>15p > 15, LMDT measures graph-spectral smoothness (Dirichlet energy) robust log-dispersion residuals self-tuning kk-nearest neighbors normalized Laplacian matrix.

title: LMDT: Local Manifold Dispersion Test
text: Asymptotic Kurtosis Invariance: zero-diagonal structure affinity operator asymptotically eliminates fourth-order error moments limiting variance rate O(1/n)O(1/n), providing robust size calibration heavy-tailed (e.g., Student-tt) error distributions. Fast Computational Complexity: Evaluates O(k⋅nlog⁡n)O(k \cdot n \log n) time, scaling easily thousands observations. High-Dimensional Scaling (p>50p > 50): Combines unsupervised Gavish–Donoho optimal singular-value thresholding supervised metric learning prevent noise dilution. S3 Object-Oriented Interface: Works seamlessly lm() fit objects, symbolic formulas (y ~ x1 + x2), numeric matrices. Diagnostic Visualizations: Native S3 plot() method displays null distribution log-dispersion profiles.

LMDT: Local Manifold Dispersion Test
LMDT: Local Manifold Dispersion Test
code: library(LMDT)  # Simulate regression data with non-linear heteroskedasticity set.seed(42) n <- 200 x1 <- runif(n, -2, 2) x2 <- runif(n, -2, 2) r <- sqrt(x1^2 + x2^2) sigma <- 0.3 + 3.0 * exp(-(r - 1.2)^2 / (2 * 0.3^2)) y <- 2 * x1 - x2 + rnorm(n, sd = sigma)  # Fit linear model fit <- lm(y ~ x1 + x2)  # Perform LMDT test res <- lmdt_test(fit) print(res)  # Plot diagnostic visualizations plot(res)

title: LMDT: Local Manifold Dispersion Test
code: # Regressors with ambient noise dimensions X <- matrix(rnorm(n * 60), n, 60) y <- X[, 1] + rnorm(n, sd = 1 + abs(X[, 1]))  # Use supervised metric learning or adaptive PCA denoising res_hd <- lmdt_test(X, residuals(lm(y ~ X)), denoise = "metric") summary(res_hd)

title: LMDT: Local Manifold Dispersion Test
text: method = "wild_bootstrap" (Default): Recommended finite samples non-Gaussian errors. method = "permutation": Exact non-parametric permutation calibration H0H_0. method = "asymptotic": Fast Gaussian approximation via de Jong’s Central Limit Theorem degenerate quadratic forms.

title: Local Manifold Dispersion Test for Heteroskedasticity — lmdt_test
text: x numeric design matrix regressors, formula. ... arguments passed methods. formula symbolic regression formula (e.g. y ~ x1 + x2). data optional data frame containing model variables. y numeric vector regression residuals response variable. k integer number nearest neighbors. Default uses adaptive rule thumb. method P-value calibration: "wild_bootstrap" (default), "permutation", "asymptotic". alternative Alternative hypothesis: "one.sided" (smooth manifold variance, default) "two.sided". denoise High-dimensional pre-filtering: "none" (default), "pca", "metric". B Number bootstrap permutation replications. Default 499. c Positive stabilizer log-dispersion transform. Default 1e-4. lambda Shrinkage prior metric learning. Default 0.15.

title: Local Manifold Dispersion Test for Heteroskedasticity — lmdt_test
